irregularities.message: At least one NCEI archive this project reads is more than 180 days behind the run date (GSOD/ISD were retired by NCEI on 2025-08-29; successors are SSODv2/GHCNh — see data/ghcnh_probe.json and data/isd_history.json). Every published statistic is a 1991-2020 statistic and is unaffected; the flag exists so nothing claims to describe *current* conditions from a stale archive.
